_comment: Benchmark families recognized by the registry. root_benchmark in every record must be a key here. origin = the family's original dataset (the root record's dataset, where a record exists).

MMLU.description: Massive Multitask Language Understanding (Hendrycks et al., 2021).

MMLU-Pro.description: Harder 10-option extension of MMLU (Wang et al., 2024).

GSM8K.description: Grade-school math word problems (Cobbe et al., 2021).

ARC.description: AI2 Reasoning Challenge science questions (Clark et al., 2018).

Belebele.description: Multilingual reading comprehension in 122 language variants (Bandarkar et al., 2023).

MGSM.description: Multilingual GSM8K subset, human-translated into 10 languages (Shi et al., 2022).

FLORES.description: FLORES/FLORES+ many-to-many translation evaluation sentences (NLLB team; OLDI).

TyDiQA.description: Typologically diverse QA collected natively in 11 languages (Clark et al., 2020).

SIB-200.description: Topic classification over FLORES-200 sentences in 200+ languages (Adelani et al., 2024).

Alpaca.description: Self-instruct-style instruction dataset (Taori et al., 2023); ancestor of several translated instruction-eval sets.

MMLU-Redux.description: Re-annotated MMLU subset with per-item error labels (Gema et al., 2024).

SQuAD.description: Stanford Question Answering Dataset (Rajpurkar et al., 2016); root of XQuAD and other translated variants.

CommonsenseQA.description: Commonsense QA over ConceptNet (Talmor et al., 2019).

XNLI.description: NLI dev/test professionally translated into 15 languages; MT train (Conneau et al., 2018).

Other-native.description: Native-original benchmarks that are not members of a translated family but serve as provenance contrast rows (e.g. KazMMLU, CMMLU, KMMLU, ArabicMMLU, TurkishMMLU).
